task.description:
Step 1 — Root-cause diagnosis for GH-759 / ISS-0697.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/759
Local ISS: docs/issues/ISS-0697.json (created in Step 0.5)

Perform a root-cause diagnosis. This MUST include:

1. Symptom confirmation: Run `python tools/lint_test_isolation.py --no-baseline --json tests/integration` and confirm the live T010 BLOCKER count = 75 and total issues = 117. Then `cat tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json` and confirm it still expects T010=74 / total=116 / platform_admin=14. Then read `tests/integration/gh512_t010_regression_test.zig` and confirm the `t010_blocker_ceiling` constant = 74.

2. Evidence trail:
   - The drift was introduced by commit 34d7ca13 (WF02-idn05-20260812, GH-746) which added tests/integration/idn05_role_registry_test.zig with a platform-admin UUID RETAIN entry. That commit regenerated tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json (74→75 T010) but did NOT update gh512_t010_regression_test.zig's ceiling constant or the snapshot fixture.
   - The same fix was applied on branch feature/WF03-GH752-20260812 in commit 0fff689f (fix(test-infra): resync gh512_t010_regression_test ceiling/snapshot to on-main baseline (ISS-0692/GH-757)) — but that fix was NOT merged to main because the squash-merge of GH-752 (commit 9d06bdf4) did not include it.
   - This is the THIRD recurrence of this drift class (see ISS-0648/GH-653 and ISS-0664/GH-701).

3. Why it matters:
   - TC-RG-01 / TC-RG-02 in tests/integration/gh512_t010_regression_test.zig fail on every fresh test run against main because the live lint scan reports 75 T010 BLOCKERs but the test asserts the ceiling is 74.
   - zig build test-env-verify's C4 check (schema baseline delta) also fires.

4. Proposed remediation (high-level only — Step 2 will design):
   - Cherry-pick commit 0fff689f's source changes (only the file changes to tests/integration/gh512_t010_regression_test.zig and tests/specs/fixtures/gh512-baseline-snapshot.json — NOT the docs/issues/ISS-0692.json since ISS-0697 already exists).
   - Verify with: `zig build test-env-verify` exits 0 AND `zig build test-integration-gh512 --summary all` shows 3/3 tests passed.

5. Risk assessment:
   - Severity = MINOR (test infrastructure only — does not affect production).
   - Blast radius = 2 files, ~5 lines changed.
   - No schema/migration/HTTP/auth changes.

6. Hard-gate pre-checks:
   - Does the fix touch a tenant-data path? NO. So SECURITY-REVIEWER (Step 2c) is NOT required.
   - Does the fix add/modify business logic? NO. So TEST-DESIGNER / TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR are NOT required (we are only updating test fixtures).
   - The fix is mechanical and small. Justification for skipping Step 2/2b is acceptable IF the diagnosis is unambiguous; otherwise still proceed with Step 2.

DO NOT:
- Modify source code (that's Step 3)
- Push to remote
- Merge anything
- File a new GitHub issue (GH-759 already exists)

After diagnosis, write a 'diagnosis report' into docs/issues/ISS-0697.json's `root_cause_analysis`, `acceptance_criteria`, and `evidence_file` fields. Then update the handoff file with status=COMPLETED, completed_at, and a result.summary that captures the diagnosis.

context.why_unmerged: Squash-merge of GH-752 (9d06bdf4) did not include 0fff689f.

result.summary: ISS-0697 / GH-759 root-cause diagnosis complete. DRIFT-INTRODUCING COMMIT = 34d7ca13 (WF02-idn05-20260812, GH-746 -- added idn05_role_registry_test.zig with platform-admin UUID RETAIN at line 70, regenerated baseline 74->75/116->117 but never updated snapshot/ceiling). Predecessor fix 0fff689f on feature/WF03-GH752-20260812 correctly applied all three artifact updates (test ceiling 74->75, snapshot v4->v5 with snapshot_v5_addendum, baseline helpers.zig T020 line-number re-sync) but was NOT included in the squash-merge of GH-752 (9d06bdf4) so main remains stale. Third recurrence of this drift class (predecessors: ISS-0648/GH-653, ISS-0664/GH-701). Severity=MINOR, blast radius=3 test-infra files (test + snapshot + baseline line-number sync), no production code path affected. Step 2c (SECURITY-REVIEWER) NOT required. Step 4/4b (TEST-DESIGNER/VALIDATOR) NOT required (test fixture update, not business logic). RECOMMEND SKIPPING Step 2/2b (CODE-DESIGNER/VALIDATOR) -- diagnosis is unambiguous, predecessor fix 0fff689f is a fully-specified mechanical change to three test-infra files, cherry-picking has zero design ambiguity (precedent: ISS-0664 was resolved by a single-commit direct fix 48d4add1 with no Step 2 pass).
